yDOzsceJ3XKARMyzg81Ae.title: Go further
yDOzsceJ3XKARMyzg81Ae.notes:
There is much more to discover!

**App Features** (in Settings) — Enable integrations, habits, and other features. Go to **Settings → App Features** to see what's available.

**Boards** — Visualize your tasks in customizable Kanban-style boards. Enable them in **App Features**, then find them in the **sidebar menu**.

**Schedule** — Plan your day by scheduling tasks at specific times. Drag tasks onto the **Schedule** view in the sidebar to organize your timeline.

**Integrations** — Once enabled in App Features, import tasks from Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, OpenProject, CalDAV, and many more. You can also integrate your calendar. Configure them in the **Issue Provider Panel**.

**Habits** — Track recurring habits and routines. Find them in the **sidebar menu** once enabled.

**Plugins** — Add features like the Procrastination Buster, Automations, or Voice Reminders. Go to **Settings → Plugins**.

**Customize** — Themes, dark mode, keyboard shortcuts, language, and productivity helpers are all in **Settings**.

NDRZGvMYNkm-ho6I9n2yN.title: Say hi to TARGENE (TMLE.jl) after package registration
NDRZGvMYNkm-ho6I9n2yN.notes:
Once CausalDynamics / CausalTargeted (and DAGMakie if relevant) are registered with a stable public face, send a short friendly hello to TARGENE.

Why
• Already depend on TMLE.jl and point readers at it for ATE (Ch. 20 / prepare_for_tmle).
• Packages sit next to theirs: graphs/ID + LMTP/mediation — not a competing ATE TMLE.
• Complementary intro after registration signals willingness to collaborate, not "adopt our unfinished fork."

How
• Prefer a GitHub Discussion or short issue on https://github.com/TARGENE/TMLE.jl (or org contact if published).
• Lead with complementarity: TMLE.jl for CM/ATE/AIE; CausalTargeted for continuous MTP/LMTP/mediation; CausalDynamics feeds adjustment sets via prepare_for_tmle.
• Offer concrete optional help: docs/examples for graph→Ψ workflows, interop notes, bug reports, small PRs — not "please merge our LMTP into TMLE."
• Link registry pages, JOSS/Zenodo DOIs if available, and one paragraph on scope.
• No pressure: happy to stay separate; open to aligning APIs or citing each other if useful.

Timing
• After registration (or clear v0.x with docs + README that already cites TMLE.jl).
• Pre-registration only with low expectations ("early packages; ping again when registered").

Tone to avoid
• Claiming to be "the Julia TMLE stack."
• Implying their package is incomplete for our use cases.
• Asking them to redesign around CausalDynamics before shared use cases exist.

Decision already taken
• Keep CausalTargeted separate (lmtp/crumble layer); use/contribute to TMLE.jl for point-treatment CM/ATE/AIE and bridge improvements.
• Contribute upstream only when the feature also helps GWAS / categorical multi-treatment users without CausalDynamics.
